title: Countryman Lines and the Continuum Hypothesis
summary: We explore the prospect of basis-like results for the class of Aronszajn lines which are consistent with the Continuum Hypothesis (CH). In particular, we prove that each of the following statements is consistent with CH: Any two Countryman lines contain isomorphic or anti-isomorphic uncountable suborders; for any coherent Aronszajan tree $T \subseteq {}^{< ω_1} ω$, the filter $\mathcal{U}(T)$ is an ultrafilter.
